cohort_summary: Live/in-game bettors found the Live Markets tab's pitch-by-pitch log, graded calls and win-prob sparklines genuinely novel, and Home's Live Decisions cards (Biggest Swing, Due Up) a strong glance surface. But the cohort's core loop - see a live number, compare to the live book price, act within seconds - breaks at every step: no live prices anywhere, the Live tab shows a frozen pregame total while the live total hides in a Home pill, no next-inning runs model, freshness shows fetch time not pitch time, and alerts are silenced exactly when needed because polling stops when the tab is hidden (and there is no push on phones). Multi-game monitoring is weaker on the Live tab than on Home. 0/10 full success; 6 partial, 4 failed.

top_cohort_issues.title: No live sportsbook price next to any live model number
top_cohort_issues.fix: Next to every live probability show the best live book price, implied/no-vig prob, edge in pts, and the quote's age (e.g. 'DK -115 · 52.1% nv · +4.3 · 6s ago'); sort Top Call by edge vs book, not lift vs league.

top_cohort_issues.title: Alerts can't fire when the tab is in the background, which is the only time OS notifications are used
top_cohort_issues.fix: Keep a slow poll (or SSE/push via service worker) while hidden and evaluate alerts there; offer web-push/PWA so phones get alerts with the app closed.

top_cohort_issues.title: Live Markets shows only the frozen pregame total; the live total is buried on Home
top_cohort_issues.fix: Render LIVE TOTAL (projected runs, line, P(over)) in the Live game rail and Other-live cards, with pregame as a small 'opened' reference like win prob.

top_cohort_issues.title: No next-inning / half-inning runs model (NRFI-style live)
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add 'NEXT HALF-INNING: P(≥1 run)' and expected runs with due-up hitters, on the hero and other-live cards.

top_cohort_issues.title: Phone live hero fills the screen; WP, totals, pitcher pitch count are 3-4 screens down
top_cohort_issues.fix: Sticky compact game strip (score, count, outs, WP, live total, pitch count) at top; collapse the 4-row distribution bars to a single line.

top_cohort_issues.title: Only one game is detailed at a time; other games are thin cards
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a compact multi-game grid/'cockpit' mode on desktop: per game WP, live total P(over), next-half-inning runs, current AB call, pitch count, last-event age, each with book price.

top_cohort_issues.title: Alert triggers are fixed: batter up/on deck, final, ≥15-pt WP swing
top_cohort_issues.fix: Rule builder: 'notify when model vs book edge ≥ X on market M', 'live total P(over) crosses Y', 'pitcher at N pitches', 'top call lift ≥ Z'; per-pin toggles and snooze.

top_cohort_issues.title: No way to log a live bet, its price, or track CLV
top_cohort_issues.fix: Quick 'log bet' from any live number (market, price, stake, timestamp) with auto-grading and CLV vs the next quote.

top_cohort_issues.title: 'updated' clock ticks every poll even when nothing changed
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show 'last pitch 12s ago' / 'model as of pitch #2' (event time from the feed) plus a separate connection dot; turn amber when the last event is older than the expected pitch cadence.

top_cohort_issues.title: 8s jittered poll is slower than pitch cadence for pitch-level markets
top_cohort_issues.fix: SSE/WebSocket push for the selected game; show a 'pitch #N' sequence id on the hero.

top_cohort_issues.title: Pitcher K/Outs lines on Live are base pregame models; no in-game re-projection vs pitch count
top_cohort_issues.fix: Re-project remaining Ks/Outs from current pitch count, Ks so far, and leash; show 'needs 3 more Ks in ~38 pitches'.

top_cohort_issues.title: Live 'Top call' ranks by lift over league, not edge vs market
top_cohort_issues.fix: Offer a rank toggle: 'vs league' | 'vs book'; when no price exists say so explicitly on the card.

top_cohort_issues.title: At-bat/pitch call accuracy shows '—' early, so no confidence in micro-markets
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show season/last-7-day calibration for each micro-market (Brier, hit rate by bucket) when the per-game sample is empty.

top_cohort_issues.title: Batter rail mixes frozen pregame and live rest-of-game numbers
top_cohort_issues.fix: Lead with REST OF GAME (the live-bettable number) large; demote frozen pregame to a reference line.

top_cohort_issues.title: Default 'Top call now' view silently switches games as the leader changes
top_cohort_issues.fix: Default to the last game the user picked; show 'Top call moved to LAD@SD →' as a nudge instead of swapping the whole hero.

top_cohort_issues.title: Other-live cards show a generic next-pitch call, no totals/edges
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show each card's strongest market-relevant number (live total P(over), next-inning run prob, batter rest-of-game HR) and its edge, and sort cards by edge.

top_cohort_issues.title: On phone the Watching row and game chips overflow sideways; alerts bell is cut off
top_cohort_issues.fix: Wrap or add edge-fade + scroll hint; move alerts bell into the header; make game chips a sticky segmented scroller.

top_cohort_issues.title: Due Up card shows frozen pregame prob; tapping lands on the current batter, not the due-up hitter
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show rest-of-game HR on Due Up and deep-link to a batter-focused live panel.

top_cohort_issues.title: No hotkeys to switch games on a second screen
top_cohort_issues.fix: 1-9 to jump to live game N, T for Top call, A to toggle alerts, ←/→ to cycle games.

top_cohort_issues.title: 'BASE' tag on live numbers not explained in context
top_cohort_issues.fix: Tooltip/inline glossary: 'Base = league rates × 30-day form, not yet adjusted for X'.

top_cohort_issues.title: Full innerHTML re-render on each changed poll can reset scroll/taps
top_cohort_issues.fix: Patch changed nodes only (as patchClocks already does) and preserve scroll anchor.
